description: Why the goods came back. Structured so returns can be reported on by reason — the free-text detail goes in Remarks. Mandatory for app returns (enforced in vansale.api.sales_return.save) rather than via reqd, so desk users amending historical credit notes are not blocked.
Cash = paid on or before invoice date; Credit = paid later. Set automatically.

label: Price List

label: Disable Automatic Payment
name: Supplier-custom_disable_auto_payment
Company-custom_block_period_closing_on_open_items
label: Block Period Closing on Open Items
description: If enabled, a Period Closing Voucher cannot be submitted while the period still carries items waiting to be billed, delivered or received. The list is shown on the voucher either way.

name: Company-custom_disable_sdbnb_in_sr
label: Disable Stock Delivered But Not Billed in Sales Return

name: Company-custom_enable_stock_billed_but_not_delivered
label: Enable Stock Billed But Not Delivered
description: If enabled, an invoice raised before delivery recognises the cost against the Stock Billed But Not Delivered account, which the delivery then clears.

name: Company-custom_enable_stock_delivered_but_not_billed
label: Enable Stock Delivered But Not Billed
description: If enabled, the value of goods delivered before invoicing will be recorded in the Stock Delivered But Not Billed account.

name: Sales Invoice Item-custom_sbnd_valuation_rate
label: SBND Valuation Rate
description: Valuation rate frozen when the invoice was submitted ahead of delivery, kept so a repost reproduces the same cost.

name: Stock Entry-custom_expense_account
label: Expense Account (All Items)
description: Applied to every item row when the entry is saved. Leave it blank to set the account row by row instead.
